title: The Pain of Powerlessness
fullTitle: Soul Snack # 36: The Pain of Powerlessness
description: In this Soul Snack Gary explores one of the deepest and most universal human experiences: the pain of powerlessness . He reveals how this pain manifests as feelings of unworthiness, isolation, and the belief that we are flawed beyond repair – and how these internal experiences have historically led us to seek external power as a form of relief. But in today’s evolving world, that strategy no longer works. Gary shares how this shift marks a turning point in our spiritual evolution.
True healing and transformation require us to respond to life not by controlling the world around us, but by cultivating authentic power from within .

This Soul Snack invites listeners to stop resisting painful experiences and instead see them as essential to their spiritual growth. When we meet our powerlessness with compassion and curiosity, we begin to transform fear into meaning, connection, and joy.
Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

Think of a moment when you felt unworthy, unloved, or incapable of love. How did you react? Did you try to change your outer world to escape those feelings? Now, reflect on how you might respond differently next time. Could you bring compassion to yourself instead of judgment? Could you see that moment as a call for healing—not proof of your inadequacy? This is your opportunity to begin creating authentic power.
Are you making choices in love or fear? Take this self-assessment today to find out.
